headline: Nano Banana Pro Prompts Recommend Skill - AI Image
short_description: Recommends image prompts from 7000+ Nano Banana Pro prompts. Benefits operations teams by automating prompt selection for AI image generation. Connects to Claude Code and Cursor workflows.
author: YouMind-OpenLab

sections.overview:
The Nano Banana Pro Prompts Recommend skill automates the selection of image generation prompts from a curated collection of over 7000 pre-built templates. It integrates directly into Claude Code and Cursor development environments, enabling teams to quickly access professional-grade prompts without manual searching. The skill reduces the time spent on prompt engineering by recommending contextually appropriate prompts based on user needs. Operations teams benefit from streamlined workflows that connect prompt selection directly to AI image generation pipelines. This automation eliminates repetitive prompt creation tasks and ensures consistency across image generation projects.
Automating prompt selection for batch AI image generation in content pipelines
Reducing manual prompt engineering overhead in design operations workflows
Enabling Claude Code and Cursor users to access curated prompts mid-development
Standardizing image generation prompts across teams and projects
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/YouMind-OpenLab/nano-banana-pro-prompts-recommend-skill`
sections.usage:
```
Recommend 3 optimized Nano Banana Pro prompts for generating [STYLE] images of [SUBJECT]. Focus on prompts that maximize [QUALITY_METRIC] while minimizing [COMMON_ISSUE]. Include the exact prompt text and a brief explanation of why each works for this use case. Prioritize prompts that work well with Nano Banana Pro v2.1 or later.
```
Copy

```
Here are three optimized Nano Banana Pro prompts for generating hyper-realistic architectural visualization images of modern office buildings at golden hour, focusing on lighting quality while minimizing over-saturation:

1. **Golden Hour Skyscraper Drama**
   *Prompt:* "Ultra-realistic 3D render of a sleek glass skyscraper at sunset, golden hour lighting casting long dramatic shadows across reflective surfaces, cinematic composition with low angle shot, 8K resolution, octane render, physically accurate materials, subtle lens flare, depth of field, architectural photography style, --ar 16:9 --v 5"
   *Why it works:* The golden hour lighting specification ensures warm, natural tones while the octane render engine produces photorealistic reflections. The low angle shot emphasizes the building's height and the 8K resolution guarantees crisp details for professional presentations.

2. **Minimalist Corporate Campus**
   *Prompt:* "Minimalist architectural photography of a corporate campus at dusk, soft purple-blue sky gradient, clean geometric lines, subtle interior lighting visible through floor-to-ceiling windows, shallow depth of field, 50mm lens perspective, muted color palette with pops of warm amber from interior lights, --ar 3:2 --v 5 --chaos 20"
   *Why it works:* The dusk setting provides a sophisticated color palette while the shallow depth of field draws attention to the building's architectural details. The chaos parameter adds subtle atmospheric haze for a more natural look.

3. **Urban Oasis Reflection**
   *Prompt:* "Architectural visualization of a modern glass pavilion surrounded by reflecting pools, mirror-like water surfaces capturing the warm sunset colors, symmetrical composition, ultra-sharp focus on building edges, professional architectural photography style, --ar 1:1 --v 5 --stylize 750"
   *Why it works:* The reflecting pools double the visual impact while maintaining symmetry. The stylize parameter enhances the artistic quality without compromising architectural accuracy, perfect for social media marketing materials.

*Pro Tip:* For the best results in Nano Banana Pro, add these parameters to any prompt: --v 5 --style raw --ar [your aspect ratio] --chaos 15-30. Test these prompts with your specific building model for optimal alignment with your design vision.",
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
